title_zh: 约定在投诉报道中隐藏未获同意的身份细节

scenario.label_zh: 确定投诉报道中的隐私边界
scenario.goal_zh: 区分否认与事实核实，并约定保留回应、删除可能暴露投诉人的细节

context_zh: 虚构社区新闻编辑室讨论一篇尚未发布的投诉报道。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: The manager sent a denial of the complaint. Does that settle the story?

sentences.speaker: Malcolm
sentences.text: No. We should report the response, but it is not an independent check of what happened.

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: The draft also includes the complainant's job title. That could disclose who she is.

sentences.speaker: Malcolm
sentences.text: She agreed to describe the incident, not to have her identity published. We need more discretion here.

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: Would removing her name be enough?

sentences.speaker: Malcolm
sentences.text: Not if her role identifies her. That would still be an unintended disclosure.

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: I will remove the name and the specific job title, keep the manager's response, and mark the disputed details as unverified.

sentences.speaker: Malcolm
sentences.text: Good. Send me that version before publication.
